propositions: PydanticAIRunner.run cyclomatic complexity exceeds committed baseline ceiling (24) due to a try/except block added in commit aec1 that captures run-shape telemetry on success path
C901 complexity ratchet gate was bypassed during Gerrit rebase without reverification, violating ADR-0047 hazard assumptions and leaving origin/main in a failing state

Extract the success-path run_shape/shape_only try/except logic into a module-level helper function _merge_success_run_shape that mutates usage dict in place to reduce PydanticAIRunner.run complexity back to baseline

The extracted helper must preserve the existing behavior of merging shape_only keys and limits into the usage record, as validated by tests test_the_success_row_records_the_tool_call_shape_too and test_the_success_row_carries_the_limits_and_duration_it_ran_under

The extracted helper must swallow run_shape/shape_only reducer failures with warning log and leave the usage dict unchanged, as validated by test_success_shape_capture_swallows_reducer_failure_and_warns
